name: CLITE
recent: Chemlite Innovation Berhad 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日实施长期激励计划（LTIP），涵盖员工认股权计划和股份授予计划，上限为已发行股份的 10%。公司 2026 财年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收环比增长 11.4%，但净利环比下降 50.9%。近期无其他重大公告或新闻。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 8 月 17 日实施长期激励计划（LTIP），包括员工认股权计划和股份授予计划，上限为已发行股份的 10%。
risks: LTIP 可能涉及发行新股，占已发行股份最多 10%，或对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 9,392,000，环比增长 11.4%，同比增长 5.5%；净利为 MYR 518,000，环比下降 50.9%，同比下降 36.9%；净利率为 5.5%，低于上一季度的 12.5%。

recent_en: Chemlite Innovation Berhad implemented a Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) on 17 August 2026, comprising an Employees' Share Option Scheme and a Share Grant Scheme, capped at 10% of issued shares. Revenue for 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June) rose 11.4% QoQ, while net profit fell 50.9% QoQ. No other major announcements or news recently.
notable_en: The company implemented a Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) on 17 August 2026, comprising an Employees' Share Option Scheme and a Share Grant Scheme, capped at 10% of issued shares.
risks_en: The LTIP may involve the issuance of new shares of up to 10% of issued shares, potentially diluting existing shareholders' equity.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 9,392,000, up 11.4% QoQ and 5.5% YoY; net profit was MYR 518,000, down 50.9% QoQ and 36.9% YoY; net margin was 5.5%, down from 12.5% in the previous quarter.
